title: Book Two · Chapter 96: Something for Next Term
story:
The school term is nearly over. One afternoon, Miss Wu brings a small book to the reading group. It has only a few pages. Many children used it. Its edges are soft.

Miss Wu opens the book. Inside are a few words about places in the school. There is a simple picture of a doorway, but some information is old.

“Next term, younger children will come,” she says. “They will need help to find the book room and the borrowing corner.”

Ronan sits straighter. He knows those places. He knows the old train book and the desk marks. He can find the low shelf easily from the gate.

“We can make a small booklet for them,” Miss Wu says. “A few children can help after the holiday. We will check the places and the words together.”

Jun looks at the little book. He puts his hands flat on the desk. He moves them apart, about the width of a page.

“Can we work in pairs?” he asks.

“Yes. Tell me next week if you are interested. We will choose the work at the start of next term.”

Ronan wants to begin at once. He can already imagine a neat title with his name under it. He opens his exercise book to a blank page.

Then Miss Wu closes the old booklet.

“This is for next term. Finish today's reading first.”

Ronan leaves the page blank. He looks at Jun. Jun lifts his eyebrows, but does not say yes to anything yet.

In today's story, a man takes a bag from a bench. It is the wrong bag. Ronan reads it with the others. At the end, his own bag is still under his seat. Leo makes a soft noise of surprise. Ronan laughs and follows the next line.

After the lesson, Jun walks beside him to the door.

“The little book could be useful,” Jun says.

“Yes. We know the school.”

“Some parts.”

Ronan wants to answer that he knows all the important parts. Then he remembers the left turn from the garden gate. He nods instead.

Outside, the yard is bright with late sun. Jun asks if he wants a short game before they leave. Ronan puts his exercise book away. The blank page stays blank.

They play ball for a few minutes. Then the gate bell rings. They stop. The new booklet is still an idea in Miss Wu's room. They make no copies or pictures today. They promise nothing to a newcomer.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

term＝学期；booklet＝小册子；newcomer＝新生。

## 理解问题

1. 小册准备为谁解决什么问题？
2. 这项工作什么时候开始？

## 读句子

**Miss Wu / opens / the book.** Miss Wu／打开／一本小册子。
